_readme: Spryker pack knowledge. STABLE: standard_unit_prefixes, standard_dirs, entry_point_patterns and override_patterns come from the platform's module conventions and change only with a Spryker major line. SEED: deprecation_patterns are portability blockers rather than a vendor deprecation list (Spryker publishes migration guides per module, not one platform deprecation table), and the two target_* lists were derived from general platform knowledge - re-verify every Glue resource and content type against the MODULE versions the project pins. `standard_units` stays empty: it is generated per project from vendor/spryker*/*/composer.json package names.

entry_point_patterns.frontend: Yves controller: class extending AbstractController (Spryker\Yves\Kernel\Controller\AbstractController / SprykerShop\Yves\...\Controller) plus its route in the module's RouteProviderPlugin
entry_point_patterns.api: Glue: class extending AbstractGlueResource, implementing GlueResourceInterface, or extending AbstractResourceRoutePlugin (resource route registration); in the newer Glue Backend/Storefront API application: an ApiResource with its *ResourcePlugin registered in GlueApplicationDependencyProvider
entry_point_patterns.admin: Zed controller extending AbstractController with an entry in navigation.xml, and Zed GUI table/form classes
entry_point_patterns.facade: *Facade / *FacadeInterface in <Module>/Business (Zed) or <Module> (Client/Service) - the only sanctioned cross-module entry point
entry_point_patterns.queue: queue consumer plugin registered in QueueDependencyProvider (RabbitMQ queue name in the plugin)
entry_point_patterns.widget: Twig widget: class extending AbstractWidget registered in ShopApplicationDependencyProvider::getGlobalWidgets or a module widget plugin list
entry_point_patterns.oms: OMS command/condition plugin registered in OmsDependencyProvider and referenced by name in config/Zed/oms/*.xml

override_patterns.class_shadowing_namespace_prefixes: A `Pyz\...` class extending or overriding a Spryker class with the same short name is the NORMAL extension pattern in Spryker - classify as `extended` and weight it low. It becomes `overridden` only when it replaces the vendor class in the wiring: a *DependencyProvider returning the Pyz plugin/factory instead of the Spryker one, or a plugin removed/reordered in a plugin stack. A patched file under vendor/ (or a project class declared in a `Spryker\` namespace) is `core-patch`.
override_patterns.dependency_provider_stack: a *DependencyProvider method whose returned plugin stack differs from the vendor default (added, removed, reordered or replaced plugins) - the single most important override signal in a Spryker project
override_patterns.transfer_extension: *.transfer.xml adding properties to a core transfer object; `strict` mode changes validation semantics - note which
override_patterns.twig_theme_override: a template at the same path under src/Pyz/Yves/ShopUi/Theme/<theme>/ replacing the vendor template (theme inheritance)
override_patterns.config_switch: config/Shared/config_default*.php (or store/environment config) setting a constant that switches a strategy or feature flag
override_patterns.core_patch: modified file under vendor/spryker, vendor/spryker-shop or vendor/spryker-eco - highest risk, name the file

deprecation_patterns: Propel queries executed in a Yves controller or template (storefront reads must come from the Redis/Elasticsearch read model via Publish & Synchronize)
getRepository() / direct persistence access from Yves
SessionClient usage for state that a headless frontend or a separate application cannot see
business logic in Zed that is never exposed through a Glue resource (blocks any headless or partner frontend)
cross-module access that bypasses a Facade (direct use of another module's Business/Persistence classes)
logic in Twig templates instead of widgets or view models
long-running or external calls inside a request instead of a queue consumer
integration_signals: *Connector / *Api modules containing an HTTP client (ERP, PIM, CRM, tax, payment, carrier)
queue adapters and RabbitMQ queue names used as an integration buffer
DataImport plugins reading files delivered by an external system
OMS commands calling an external service (fulfilment, payment capture)
Publish & Synchronize pipelines feeding an external search or storage service
source_content_component_pattern: CMS block and slot templates (`@CmsBlock/...` Twig includes, slot provider declarations in the theme templates) plus the `cms_block` / `cms_page` / `cms_slot` data-import CSV names under data/import/**; content items (banner, abstract product list, product set, file list, navigation) referenced through content-item widgets
target_api_endpoint_families: /checkout-data and /checkout (checkout data collection and order placement)
/access-tokens and /refresh-tokens (OAuth2 authentication for the Storefront API)
Glue Backend API (backend gateway) resources for back-office and integration use - separate application, separate authentication (/token, /dynamic-entity/* for the Dynamic Data API)
target_content_component_types: CMS page (with page templates and localised versions)
CMS block (reusable content record placed through slots or Twig)
CMS slot + slot provider (declared in the Twig template, defines where blocks may appear)
CMS block category / product / template relations (contextual placement)
product set (curated set with its own landing page)
glossary key / translation record (all storefront copy)
Yves theme component: atom / molecule / organism / template / view (ShopUi, project code)
Twig widget (AbstractWidget, project code) as the dynamic-content mechanism

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
